text_block_list.text: Whew. I managed to come in first place.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Yes, but this win is nothing special. It's
merely the
natural consequence of our
daily efforts.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Our training must continue, and we
should not
grow complacent.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Even so, I'm glad you won!

text_block_list.text:
Yes. One must wear one's helm most
firmly in the
moment of victory, as the
saying goes.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
However, this is only one stop on the
way to the
top. So please—continue on
this journey with me.

text_block_list.text:
So please remain vigilant as you guide
me
forward. ♪
